env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# Six fields nested five deep expands 6^5 copies. The incremental
# budget must trip before the product materializes.
cd wnest
! logos build ./...
stderr 'comptime::node_limit'
cd ..

-- wnest/go.mod --
module example.com/nestedlimit

go 1.27

-- wnest/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"comptime"
	"fmt"
)

type S struct {
	F0 int
	F1 int
	F2 int
	F3 int
	F4 int
	F5 int
}

func show(v S) int {
	n := 0
	const for _, f0 := range comptime.Fields[S]() {
		const for _, f1 := range comptime.Fields[S]() {
			const for _, f2 := range comptime.Fields[S]() {
				const for _, f3 := range comptime.Fields[S]() {
					const for _, f4 := range comptime.Fields[S]() {
						n += v.[f0] + v.[f1] + v.[f2] + v.[f3] + v.[f4]
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	return n
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println(show(S{}))
}
